plan.disposition: Mini-Plan is FEATURE-only at small complexity (Phase Matrix); this is a change/bug-type fix, so no plan artifact is generated.

findings.finding: The on-photo.css guard located rule-2 with a single-LINE predicate; a future reflow of the long :is() selector across lines would make the predicate return undefined and fail with a misleading 'selector not found' rather than the real 'wz-outline missing' signal.
findings.suggestion: Match the whole :is(...) block with a whitespace-tolerant regex. FIXED: rewrote the predicate to css.match(/.on-photo :is(...)/g) over the whole file.

findings.finding: Back at /wizard/new step 1 resets to INITIAL_STATE (picker) while the URL stays /wizard/new; a reload then jumps back to the first question. Pre-existing for adopt/grade; newly reachable for the new door.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is (matches documented adopt/grade Back semantics). ACCEPTED: not fixed to avoid scope creep; spec-reviewer confirmed no scope creep is the right posture.

findings.finding: WzOutline explicitly merges className while WzPrimary lets it flow through ...rest implicitly; the asymmetry reads as an oversight.
findings.suggestion: Add a clarifying comment. FIXED: added a comment on WzPrimary noting it intentionally has no reset hook.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the visual baselines legitimately change and the change is ready to ship — wizard-new.png does not yet exist and wizard-adopt/grade.png will change pixels (WzOutline Back button re-colored); baselines are Linux-only and cannot be regenerated on this win32 worktree.

Claim under doubt: Back from /wizard/new returns the user cleanly to the picker — Functionally correct (reducer step<=1 -> INITIAL_STATE -> picker); only residue is a URL/state desync (address bar stays /wizard/new). Pre-existing for adopt/grade.

external_code.disposition: External LLM code review is mandatory only at medium+ per the Phase Matrix; complexity is small, no risk flags, diff under 100 lines.

plan_internal.disposition: Internal Plan Review is a medium+-only gate per iteration-planning.md; this run is small with no mini-plan.
